title: NSE IPO: No more India’s biggest! From DRHP to RHP | Price, size to stake sale — Top 5 changes to know for investors
text: NSE IPO: No more India’s biggest! From DRHP to RHP | Price, size to stake sale — Top 5 changes to know for investors. NSE IPO size: The exchange has reduced its offer from around 14.89 crore to 12,64,36,650 leading to reduction in the offer size from ₹30,000 crore to ₹22,569 crore
